author: F2F official
description: A desert old town at night, lit by lanterns, braziers and strings of bulbs, on two levels. A, Dyers' Court, up on the defenders' plateau: climb the long Spice Road to the Spice Arch, or the Balcony Steps off mid. B, Cistern Yard, down in the low town: through the covered Souk or Lantern Passage. Mid bends twice up to the Mid Doors and the Mid Steps.
name: Saffra
